teaser: This issue centers on nurses' readiness for AI and testing AI tools against real work. Several papers measure digital literacy, competence, or anxiety among nursing and allied health students, generally finding that ethics-focused and cognitive literacy matter alongside technical skill. A second thread tests large language models on nursing text, including handover transcripts, discharge letters, and free-text care notes, with mixed accuracy and ongoing uncertainty about clinical readiness. A third thread examines decision support design and use, from a long-term care prototype to participatory design practices and ICU nurses' experiences with AI and missed care.

themes.name: AI readiness and literacy in nursing education
